activity.notes: Ogdo (Yevdokiya) Aksyonova helped establish Dolgan written literature and develop its written language. The publication of Baraksan in 1973 anchors this representative literary activity, which continued through her later work before her death in 1995. This is cultural activity for the Dolgan community, not a reign or government office.
